name: Jayden Okafor
psychographics: Balanced spender who enjoys occasional luxury but meticulously tracks net worth via apps; risk-averse with big purchases.
current_solutions: Uses Wealthsimple for joint investments, Instacart for grocery runs, and a shared Google Calendar for scheduling staycations.
frustration: The TD Bank mobile app crashed exactly at 6:47pm on the day his rent was due, preventing him from transferring funds and causing a late-fee scare.
decision_style: Checks credit-card rewards calculators religiously; will switch banks for a better interest rate but hates paperwork.
voice: Short, clipped, and numbers-focused; prefers data points over stories, often responding with grunts or 'yeah, no' to open-ended questions.
